name: Golden Ratio
description: A lavishly produced holographic feature commissioned by the Quanta Monetary Stability Consortium depicting the origins of the QUANTA currency system as a heroic act of collective salvation following the 'Great Volatility' of the 2150s. The film personifies economic forces as characters — inflation as a literal plague, currency stabilization as a kind of divine architecture — and presents the current tiered economic system as the natural and inevitable outcome of human cooperation. Screened in all licensed public spaces during the Consortium's annual Stability Week.
cultural_impact: Golden Ratio successfully embedded a mythological origin story for the tiered currency system into mainstream cultural consciousness, making structural economic critique feel like an attack on shared history.
story_hooks: A financial historian has compiled evidence that the film's historical consultants were paid to suppress contradictory archival data — and kept copies of what they buried.
An underground remix of Golden Ratio using only the film's own footage, recut to tell the opposite story, has become a Shelf cultural touchstone.
The film's lead holographic performance artist has begun speaking publicly about being pressured to alter their performance to remove ambiguity from the currency system's founding figures.
